native.scope: SiteSessionV18Tests: transport to detail parsing, genuine authentication, forbidden response classification, retry bounds and request scheduling

change.reproduced_before_fix: Normal gallery, list and image content containing Panda or login-related words was rejected as authentication before normal parsing
change.authentication_evidence: Login notices outside user-controlled content, or standalone legacy Panda denial responses
change.excluded_content: Gallery titles, uploader, cover and thumbnail fields, tags, comments, image content, favorite notes, category controls, script and style text

limitations: The reported individual gallery was not located by one anonymous title lookup; its actual response has not been inspected.
The code defect was reproduced with neutral response fixtures; the reported gallery root cause remains unconfirmed until its response is available.
No account cookies, passwords, raw authenticated HTML or private keys were exported for this investigation.
Installation readback and real-device UI or account acceptance are separate stages.
